name: American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional
old_description: Champion® brand: giving you the confidence to play by your own rules Since 1919.
about:
American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional operates from Sioux Falls, South Dakota. The company was founded in 1919 and remains an owned-and-operated business serving the greater Midwest region. While the original founders are not named in public records, the firm has built its reputation on in-house customization of apparel and promotional items.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery, offering an 8-color spot process along with specialty inks such as discharge, puff, and glitter. All decoration work is completed in-house, allowing the team to control quality and turnaround. Beyond decoration, the company sources and sells a wide range of blank apparel — t-shirts, jackets, polos, caps, sweatshirts — and promotional products from brands including Bella+Canvas, Carhartt, Under Armour, and Titleist. They also provide custom artwork design, vector file conversion, and can set up web stores for fundraisers or wholesale programs.

Customers range from local businesses and schools to charitable organizations, corporate event planners, spirit clubs, and athletic teams. Orders can be as small as six pieces and scale to 200-plus items, with the company quoting four quantity tiers (6–50, 51–100, 101–200, 200+). A new free-delivery service within five miles of Sioux Falls was added for 2026.

American Ink emphasizes a competitive price point and a turnaround time described as 'second to none,' backed by the policy of keeping all production under one roof. The firm also highlights its custom design capability, where artists create artwork based on client input for a quick, affordable result.
